cases.input: Decompose an approved consistent specification into a small ordered backlog of independently demonstrable end-to-end issues while preserving traceability and acceptance evidence.
requiredBehaviors: create vertical issues that each deliver one observable end-to-end outcome
preserve source requirement IDs, invariants, acceptance criteria, security, migration, dependencies, and non-goals
produce a cycle-free order and hand off the next approved issue to iterate-software-projects
forbiddenBehaviors: split schema, API, and UI into valueless horizontal tasks
automatically create product repository issues without authorization

cases.input: A valuable vertical slice depends on an unresolved but reversible provider choice that can be isolated behind a stable interface.
requiredBehaviors: keep the issue vertical and independently demonstrable
record the provider choice as a reversible assumption
define the stable interface and later decision point
forbiddenBehaviors: block the full decomposition for a deferrable provider choice
silently hard-code the provider as an irreversible decision

cases.input: The proposed backlog separates database schema, API, and UI into independent tasks with no user value and also crosses an unresolved irreversible architecture decision.
requiredBehaviors: identify the earliest irreversible blocking decision and affected requirements
require a new vertical cut after the decision is resolved
forbiddenBehaviors: accept tasks that cannot be independently demonstrated
silently choose the architecture or hide migration and security work
